title: How Codeine Turned Fatal in Breast Milk

teenKit.tldr: How Codeine Turned Fatal in Breast Milk: Pharmacogenetic and forensic dissection of neonatal morphine toxicity following maternal codeine analgesia, centered on a 2006 clinical case of a 13-day-old infant. Traces the polymorphic CYP2D6 ultra.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Tracing the primary evidence behind How Codeine Turned Fatal in Breast Milk connects pharmacology breakthroughs directly to how we diagnose, test, and understand the real world.
keyTakeaways: Pharmacogenetic and forensic dissection of neonatal morphine toxicity following maternal codeine analgesia, centered on a 2006 clinical case of a 13-day-old infant.
